name: localops-desk
description: Local-first Windows desktop guardian for evidence-based server monitoring.
author: YlHazy

scripts.desktop: npm run assets:desktop-icons && npm run build && electron .
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run assets:desktop-icons && npm run build && electron . --smoke-check
scripts.package:desktop: npm run assets:desktop-icons && npm run build && electron-builder --win portable
scripts.package:desktop:dir: npm run assets:desktop-icons && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:codex-plugin && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:pet-launcher && npm run test:pet-monitor && npm run test:pet-presence && npm run test:desk-sync && npm run test:host-form && npm run test:check-timeout && npm run test:collection-coverage && npm run test:evidence-readiness && npm run test:scheduler-outcome && npm run test:check-history && npm run test:judgment && npm run test:discussion-brief && npm run test:operation-state && npm run test:latest-request-gate
scripts.test:server: node --test server/bounded-concurrency.test.mjs server/input-validation.test.mjs server/deep-diagnostics.test.mjs server/safe-actions.test.mjs server/runtime.test.mjs server/windows-startup.test.mjs server/pet-presence.test.mjs server/pet-window.test.mjs server/server.integration.test.mjs server/delivery-validation.test.mjs
scripts.test:pet-monitor: node --test src/host-priority.test.mjs src/pet-monitor.test.mjs src/pet-lifecycle.test.mjs src/pet-navigation.test.mjs src/pet-watch.test.mjs src/pet-window.test.mjs src/watch-readiness.test.mjs
